idea.title: Weekly Surge In Google Trends For Last Minute Vacation Bookings Signals Consumer Spending Spike
idea.thesis: A sudden surge in last minute vacation booking searches often precedes increased consumer discretionary spending in travel and leisure. Increased travel interest drives higher spending on leisure and hospitality-related stocks.
data_sources: Google Trends weekly data for 'last minute vacation bookings'
idea.signal_logic: If weekly Google Trends for 'last minute vacation bookings' rises more than 30% vs prior 4-week average
idea.entry_exit: Entry: If weekly Google Trends for 'last minute vacation bookings' rises more than 30% vs prior 4-week average Exit: After 3 weeks or if the trend falls below its 4-week average
idea.position_sizing: Allocate 5% per signal, max 20% total exposure.
idea.risks: Data source instability, false positives, and regime shifts.
idea.implementation_notes: Use Google Trends weekly data for 'last minute vacation bookings' via api (weekly).
idea.reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Seasonal and impulsive travel planning frequently spikes within weeks.

idea.title: Daily Spike In Google Trends For Emergency Plumbing Service Signals Consumer Stress Lifting Home Improvement Demand
idea.thesis: Rises in emergency plumbing searches reflect urgent home repair stress, often preceding increased discretionary spending on home services. Home repair service demand supports consumer discretionary stocks focused on home improvement.
data_sources: Google Trends daily data for 'emergency plumbing service'
idea.signal_logic: If daily Google Trends for 'emergency plumbing service' exceeds 40% above 14-day average
idea.entry_exit: Entry: If daily Google Trends for 'emergency plumbing service' exceeds 40% above 14-day average Exit: After 5 trading days or when trend falls below 14-day average
idea.position_sizing: Allocate 5% per signal, max 20% total exposure.
idea.risks: Data source instability, false positives, and regime shifts.
idea.implementation_notes: Use Google Trends daily data for 'emergency plumbing service' via api (daily).
idea.reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Emergency repair needs arise frequently and generate online search spikes.
